name: Zenith Extermination
name_jp: 究極カルネージペイン
effects: Seven single target attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Physical Blink 1] to all allies, grants [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking] depending on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Kiros (Dark, Ice)] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single target attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Physical Blink 1] to all allies, grants [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking] depending on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Kiros (Dark, Ice)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Kiros (Dark, Ice)
description.text: Increases [Ice/Dark Infusion] damage damage bonuses by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Ice or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Kiros (Ice, Dark) after using two Ice or Dark abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Katar Dance+
description.text: 4/5/6 single attacks (? each) if the user has Physical Blink 0/1/2, capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, grants [Physical Blink 1] and [Physical Blink Stacking 2] to the user

description.name: Katar Dance+
description.text: 5/6/7 single attacks (? each) if the user has Physical Blink 0/1/2, grants [Physical Blink 1] and [Physical Blink Stacking 2] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Kiros (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to the user if 0 members have Physical Blink, grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to all allies and [Buff Prismatic +10%] to allies with Physical Blink

description.name: Physical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next PHY attack that deals physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attack that deals physical or fractional damage

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
